parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located under the tabletop, rectangular in shape, part of the table's storage system.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or accessories.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide in and out along rails or grooves.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden panel located at the back of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the drawer compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the left side of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the right side of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the front left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the front right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the back left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the back right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Front Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel located at the front of the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: Hides the drawer structure and provides a mounting surface for the drawer front.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides the main working or placing surface for objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
